title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
湖廣鄉試錄序
正德丙子歲當鄉試巡按湖
廣監察御史張翰謂
國家圖治莫大於興賢而人臣
事君亦惟以薦賢爲急顧茲
司考校者宜慎所舉廼集藩
臬議走幣聘幹等而提學副
punctuated:
湖廣鄉試錄序

正德丙子歲，當鄉試，巡按湖廣監察御史張翰謂：「國家圖治，莫大於興賢，而人臣事君，亦惟以薦賢爲急。顧茲司考校者，宜慎所舉。」廼集藩臬議，走幣聘幹等，而提學副
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Huguang Provincial Examination

In the bingzi year of the Zhengde reign [1516], when the Provincial Examination was due to be held, Zhang Han, Regional Inspector serving as Investigating Censor for Huguang, said: “In the state’s pursuit of good government, nothing is more important than promoting worthy men. Likewise, for ministers serving their ruler, recommending worthy men is the most urgent duty. Those charged with examining and assessing candidates must therefore take care in choosing whom to recommend.” He then assembled officials of the Provincial Administration and Surveillance Commissions to deliberate, and dispatched gifts to invite Gan and others to serve. And the Deputy Surveillance Commissioner for Education …

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
李文郎中唐錦伍全王宗計
宗道主事鄭玉彭大治詹晨
以公事至各贊襄之提調則
左布政使龔弘右布政使周
季鳳監試則按察使王時中
僉事謝廷柱防範則左參政
王泰右參政張天相副使惲
===
巍范希淹聶賢翁理汪賜陳
璧左參議王藎右參議夏從
壽張瀚熊紀僉事張鳴鳳高
顯丁沂顧英汪玉都指揮劉
宗仁咸克恊相諸執事亦皆
遴選以充分經校閱則學正
周禧教諭林文焯陳惟淵鄭
punctuated: 李文、郎中唐錦、伍全、王宗、計宗道、主事鄭玉、彭大治、詹晨，以公事至，各贊襄之。提調則左布政使龔弘、右布政使周季鳳；監試則按察使王時中、僉事謝廷柱；防範則左參政王泰、右參政張天相、副使惲巍、范希淹、聶賢、翁理、汪賜、陳璧、左參議王藎、右參議夏從壽、張瀚、熊紀、僉事張鳴鳳、高顯、丁沂、顧英、汪玉、都指揮劉宗仁，咸克恊相。諸執事亦皆遴選以充。分經校閱則學正周禧、教諭林文焯、陳惟淵、鄭
translation_en: …Li Wen; Bureau Directors Tang Jin, Wu Quan, Wang Zong, and Ji Zongdao; and Bureau Secretaries Zheng Yu, Peng Dazhi, and Zhan Chen arrived on official business and each assisted with the undertaking. Serving as Proctors were Left Provincial Administration Commissioner Gong Hong and Right Provincial Administration Commissioner Zhou Jifeng. Overseeing the examination were Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Wang Shizhong and Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Xie Tingzhu. Responsible for security and precautions were Left Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner Wang Tai; Right Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner Zhang Tianxiang; Surveillance Vice Commissioners Yun Wei, Fan Xiyan, Nie Xian, Weng Li, Wang Ci, and Chen Bi; Left Provincial Administration Assistant Commissioner Wang Jin; Right Provincial Administration Assistant Commissioners Xia Congshou, Zhang Han, and Xiong Ji; Assistant Surveillance Commissioners Zhang Mingfeng, Gao Xian, Ding Yi, Gu Ying, and Wang Yu; and Regional Military Commissioner Liu Zongren. All ably cooperated and assisted. The other functionaries were likewise carefully selected to fill their posts. Assigned to review the papers by individual Classic were Departmental School Instructor Zhou Xi and County School Instructors Lin Wenzhuo, Chen Weiyuan, and Zheng…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
坤吳大田李應奎訓導李佑
鄭朝美而幹與教諭魏綸寔
主其事巡按御史矢天勵眾
監臨而三試之拔其尤得八
十五人錄其名及文以
獻幹謹拜稽而為之序曰三代
聖王以道化天下天下士非
===
道弗學學成而官之謨謀贊
畫動協于道故其治莫尚焉
周衰孔子述先王之道著之
六經漢興號稱表章顧其為
教猶駁而不純隋唐而後專
事詞章習浮艷而去道日遠
夫上之所取而用之者若是
punctuated:
坤、吳大田、李應奎，訓導李佑、鄭朝美，而幹與教諭魏綸寔主其事。巡按御史矢天勵眾，監臨而三試之，拔其尤，得八十五人，錄其名及文以獻。幹謹拜稽而為之序曰：
三代聖王以道化天下，天下士非道弗學，學成而官之，謨謀贊畫，動協于道，故其治莫尚焉。周衰，孔子述先王之道，著之六經。漢興，號稱表章，顧其為教猶駁而不純。隋唐而後，專事詞章，習浮艷而去道日遠。夫上之所取而用之者若是
translation_en:
…Kun, Wu Datian, and Li Yingkui, together with Assistant Instructors Li You and Zheng Chaomei; Gan and Instructor Wei Lun were in fact in charge of the undertaking. The Regional Inspector pledged himself before Heaven and exhorted everyone [?], supervising the candidates through three examination sessions. The most outstanding were selected, yielding eighty-five men, whose names and compositions were recorded for presentation to the throne. Gan respectfully bowed and kowtowed and composed this preface:
The sage kings of the Three Dynasties transformed all under Heaven through the Way. Scholars throughout the realm studied nothing other than the Way, and upon completing their studies were appointed to office. In their deliberations, counsel, and assistance with planning, their every action accorded with the Way. Thus no governance surpassed theirs. When the Zhou declined, Confucius expounded the Way of the former kings and set it down in the Six Classics. With the rise of the Han, it was purportedly honored and brought to prominence; yet the teaching remained mixed and impure. From the Sui and Tang onward, scholars devoted themselves exclusively to literary composition, cultivating superficial ornamentation and departing ever further from the Way. Now, if those whom the rulers select and employ are of this sort…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
而止也其治之不古若也固
宜宋周子程子者出知漢唐
諸儒之陋刋其支離恊于一
去其謬誤復之正然後孔子
之道明當其時猶且抑遏排
擯扼其說而不行我
太祖建國始純以經術教天下下
===
非是弗學而上非是弗取是
以百五十年治化之盛遠追
隆古亦固宜也顧夫習而不
察或取以為利禄之媒言道
學顧以為諱甚者或從而咲
之又詆訾焉何哉夫疑饑渴
者之飲食而恠夫出入之必
punctuated:
而止也，其治之不古若也，固宜。宋周子、程子者出，知漢唐諸儒之陋，刋其支離，恊于一；去其謬誤，復之正，然後孔子之道明。當其時，猶且抑遏排擯，扼其說而不行。我太祖建國，始純以經術教天下，下非是弗學，而上非是弗取。是以百五十年治化之盛，遠追隆古，亦固宜也。
顧夫習而不察，或取以為利禄之媒，言道學，顧以為諱，甚者或從而咲之，又詆訾焉，何哉？夫疑饑渴者之飲食，而恠夫出入之必
translation_en:
…and went no further, it was only natural that their government did not equal that of antiquity. Masters Zhou and Cheng emerged in the Song, recognizing the inadequacies of the Confucian scholars of the Han and Tang. They pruned away their fragmented interpretations and brought them into unity; they removed their errors and restored correctness. Only then did the Way of Confucius become clear. Yet even in their own time they were suppressed and excluded, their teachings obstructed and prevented from being put into practice. When our Taizu founded the dynasty, he began to instruct all under Heaven exclusively through classical learning. Those below studied nothing else, and those above selected men on no other basis. Thus it was also only natural that the flourishing government and moral transformation of these hundred and fifty years should rival the distant golden age of antiquity.
Yet some practice this learning without examining it, perhaps using it as a means to profit and official emoluments. When learning of the Way is mentioned, they instead treat it as taboo; some go so far as to laugh at it and even disparage it. Why is this? They question the eating and drinking of the hungry and thirsty, and find it strange that, when entering and leaving, one must…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
由戶嗚呼其惑矣誦聖賢之
言日惟其義句研而字析措
之文詞無非修齊治平之道
考其見乃背戾若是則士將
焉用習此上亦何賴而必是
之求哉維玆湖藩名山大川
甲于天下周子程子於是乎
===
生焉實以繼絕學而啓
國家文明之運矧今治隆化洽
涵濡積久之餘豈無若三子
者出其間以嗣揚丕績者乎
今觀諸士之文剖析幽微雄
深而俊雅宜若有見於道道
明矣篤信而必行之以副我
punctuated: 由戶。嗚呼，其惑矣！誦聖賢之言，日惟其義，句研而字析，措之文詞，無非修齊治平之道。考其見，乃背戾若是，則士將焉用習此，上亦何賴而必是之求哉？維玆湖藩，名山大川甲于天下，周子、程子於是乎生焉，實以繼絕學而啓國家文明之運。矧今治隆化洽，涵濡積久之餘，豈無若三子者出其間，以嗣揚丕績者乎？今觀諸士之文，剖析幽微，雄深而俊雅，宜若有見於道。道明矣，篤信而必行之，以副我
translation_en:
…through a doorway. Alas, how deluded they are! They recite the words of the sages and worthies, ponder their meaning daily, examine each sentence and analyze each character. What they set down in their compositions concerns nothing but the Way of cultivating oneself, ordering the family, governing the state, and bringing peace to the world. Yet when their views are examined, they prove so contrary to it. What use, then, is there for scholars to study these teachings, and what benefit could the ruler expect in insisting upon them when selecting men?
Here in Huguang, renowned mountains and great rivers rank foremost in the realm. Master Zhou and the Masters Cheng were born here, truly to carry on the learning whose transmission had been broken and to inaugurate an era of cultural flourishing for the dynasty. Moreover, now that government prospers and moral transformation is pervasive, after so many years of nurturing influence, surely men like those three masters might emerge here to carry forward and magnify their great achievements?
Looking now at these scholars’ compositions, I find that they analyze subtle and profound matters, and are powerful, deep, distinguished, and elegant. Their authors seem indeed to possess insight into the Way. Once the Way is understood, they must believe in it firmly and unfailingly put it into practice, thereby to meet the expectations of our …

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
皇上側席之求而措諸事業則周
子程子昔所未試而今乃獲
大行焉其宜為世道慶何如
也夫士之始進其學術之醇
疵識操之定否豈惟其終身
榮辱之機而世道隆替實於
是乎關焉司考校者惡敢弗
===
重有以勵之
直隸和州含山縣儒學教諭
林榦謹序
punctuated:
皇上側席之求，而措諸事業，則周子、程子昔所未試，而今乃獲大行焉，其宜為世道慶何如也！夫士之始進，其學術之醇疵、識操之定否，豈惟其終身榮辱之機，而世道隆替實於是乎關焉。司考校者惡敢弗重有以勵之？
直隸和州含山縣儒學教諭林榦謹序。
translation_en:
…His Majesty’s eager search for worthy men, and put this into practice in public affairs, then what Master Zhou and the Cheng masters had no opportunity to try in their own time may now be put fully into effect. What cause this would be for rejoicing over the moral condition of the age! When scholars first enter official life, the soundness or flaws of their learning, and the firmness or otherwise of their judgment and integrity, determine more than their lifelong honor or disgrace: the flourishing or decline of the moral order itself depends upon these things. How could those charged with examining them fail to take this seriously and offer them encouragement?
Preface respectfully written by Lin Gan, Instructor of the Confucian School of Hanshan County, Hezhou, in the directly administered metropolitan region (Zhili).

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
正德十一年湖廣鄉試
監臨官
巡按湖廣監察御史張翰〔汝楨騰驤右衛人乙丑進士〕
提調官
湖廣等處承宣布政使司左布政使龔弘〔元之直隸嘉定縣人戊戌進士〕
湖廣等處承宣布政使司右布政使周季鳳〔公儀江西寧州人癸丑進士〕
監試官
湖廣等處提刑按察司按察使王時中〔道夫山東黃縣人庚戌進士〕
湖廣等處提刑按察司僉事謝廷柱〔邦用福建長樂縣人己未進士〕
===
考試官
直隸和州含山縣儒學教諭林幹〔克貞福建懷安縣人甲子貢士〕
直隸保定府雄縣儒學教諭張綸〔理之山東利津縣人丁卯貢士〕
同考試官
山東東昌府臨清州儒學學正周禧〔原德江西崇仁縣人丁卯貢士〕
直隸廬州府無為州巢縣儒學教諭林文焯〔士明福建閩縣人丁卯貢士〕
直隸鳳陽府泗州盱眙縣儒學教諭陳惟淵〔主靜浙江慈谿縣人庚午貢士〕
河南衛輝府汲縣儒學教諭鄭坤〔一寧山東武定州人庚午貢士〕
河南開封府扶溝縣儒學教諭吳大田〔紹魯福建莆田縣人甲子貢士〕
punctuated:
正德十一年湖廣鄉試

監臨官：
巡按湖廣監察御史張翰〔汝楨，騰驤右衛人，乙丑進士〕。

提調官：
湖廣等處承宣布政使司左布政使龔弘〔元之，直隸嘉定縣人，戊戌進士〕。
湖廣等處承宣布政使司右布政使周季鳳〔公儀，江西寧州人，癸丑進士〕。

監試官：
湖廣等處提刑按察司按察使王時中〔道夫，山東黃縣人，庚戌進士〕。
湖廣等處提刑按察司僉事謝廷柱〔邦用，福建長樂縣人，己未進士〕。

直隸保定府雄縣儒學教諭張綸〔理之，山東利津縣人，丁卯貢士〕。

同考試官：
山東東昌府臨清州儒學學正周禧〔原德，江西崇仁縣人，丁卯貢士〕。
直隸廬州府無為州巢縣儒學教諭林文焯〔士明，福建閩縣人，丁卯貢士〕。
直隸鳳陽府泗州盱眙縣儒學教諭陳惟淵〔主靜，浙江慈谿縣人，庚午貢士〕。
河南衛輝府汲縣儒學教諭鄭坤〔一寧，山東武定州人，庚午貢士〕。
河南開封府扶溝縣儒學教諭吳大田〔紹魯，福建莆田縣人，甲子貢士〕。
translation_en:
Huguang Provincial Examination, the Eleventh Year of Zhengde (1516)

Supervising Official
Zhang Han, Investigating Censor on inspection duty in Huguang, had the courtesy name Ruzhen and was from Tengxiang Right Guard. He was a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the yichou year.

Proctors
Gong Hong, Left Administration Commissioner of the Huguang Provincial Administration Commission, had the courtesy name Yuanzhi and was from Jiading County, Zhili. He was a metropolitan graduate of the wuxu year.
Zhou Jifeng, Right Administration Commissioner of the Huguang Provincial Administration Commission, had the courtesy name Gongyi and was from Ningzhou, Jiangxi. He was a metropolitan graduate of the guichou year.

Examination Supervisors
Wang Shizhong, Surveillance Commissioner of the Huguang Provincial Surveillance Commission, had the courtesy name Daofu and was from Huang County, Shandong. He was a metropolitan graduate of the gengxu year.
Xie Tingzhu, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of the Huguang Provincial Surveillance Commission, had the courtesy name Bangyong and was from Changle County, Fujian. He was a metropolitan graduate of the jiwei year.

Examiners
Lin Gan, Instructor at the Confucian School of Hanshan County, Hezhou, Zhili, had the courtesy name Kezhen and was from Huai’an County, Fujian. He was a tribute student (gongshi) of the jiazi year.
Zhang Lun, Instructor at the Confucian School of Xiong County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili, had the courtesy name Lizhi and was from Lijin County, Shandong. He was a tribute student (gongshi) of the dingmao year.

Associate Examiners
Zhou Xi, Instructor at the Confucian School of Linqing Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong, had the courtesy name Yuande and was from Chongren County, Jiangxi. He was a tribute student (gongshi) of the dingmao year.
Lin Wenzhuo, Instructor at the Confucian School of Chao County, Wuwei Subprefecture, Luzhou Prefecture, Zhili, had the courtesy name Shiming and was from Min County, Fujian. He was a tribute student (gongshi) of the dingmao year.
Chen Weiyuan, Instructor at the Confucian School of Xuyi County, Sizhou, Fengyang Prefecture, Zhili, had the courtesy name Zhujing and was from Cixi County, Zhejiang. He was a tribute student (gongshi) of the gengwu year.
Zheng Kun, Instructor at the Confucian School of Ji County, Weihui Prefecture, Henan, had the courtesy name Yining and was from Wuding Subprefecture, Shandong. He was a tribute student (gongshi) of the gengwu year.
Wu Datian, Instructor at the Confucian School of Fugou County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, had the courtesy name Shaolu and was from Putian County, Fujian. He was a tribute student (gongshi) of the jiazi year.

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
陝西西安府高陵縣儒學教諭李應奎〔文輝山西平定州人庚午貢士〕
直隸真定府藁城縣儒學訓導李佑〔德卿山西襄垣縣人庚午貢士〕
直隸松江府華亭縣儒學訓導鄭朝美〔克之福建閩縣人庚午貢士〕
印卷官
湖廣等處承宣布政使司經歷司經歷蘇謙〔尚古直隸徐州衛人監生〕
湖廣等處提刑按察司經歷司經歷王憲〔汝成江西會昌縣人監生〕

長沙府知府陸相〔良弼浙江餘姚縣人癸丑進士〕
德安府知府馬侖〔汝載四川西充縣人己未進士〕
===
岳州府知府黃巽〔啟亨浙江鄞縣人壬戌進士〕
受卷官
荊州府知府姚隆〔原學直隸嘉定縣人壬戌進士〕
武昌府推官衛道〔正夫河南葉縣人甲戌進士〕
黃州府推官朱節〔守中浙江山陰縣人甲戌進士〕
沔陽州知州李濂〔川甫河南祥符縣人甲戌進士〕

興國州知州唐珉〔玉和浙江杭州右衛人辛酉貢士〕
punctuated:
陝西西安府高陵縣儒學教諭李應奎〔文輝，山西平定州人，庚午貢士〕。直隸真定府藁城縣儒學訓導李佑〔德卿，山西襄垣縣人，庚午貢士〕。直隸松江府華亭縣儒學訓導鄭朝美〔克之，福建閩縣人，庚午貢士〕。

印卷官
湖廣等處承宣布政使司經歷司經歷蘇謙〔尚古，直隸徐州衛人，監生〕。湖廣等處提刑按察司經歷司經歷王憲〔汝成，江西會昌縣人，監生〕。

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
述而不作信而好古
凡事豫則立不豫則廢言前定則不跲事
前定則不困行前定則不疚道前定則
不窮
有布縷之征粟米之征力役之征君子用
其一緩其二
易
===
大哉乾元萬物資始乃統天
九四大吉无咎
易簡而天下之理得矣天下之理得而成
位乎其中矣
往者屈也來者信也
書
水火金木土穀惟修
有言逆于汝心必求諸道有言遜于汝志
必求諸非道
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

述而不作，信而好古。

凡事豫則立，不豫則廢。言前定則不跲，事前定則不困，行前定則不疚，道前定則不窮。

有布縷之征，粟米之征，力役之征。君子用其一，緩其二。

易

大哉乾元！萬物資始，乃統天。

九四，大吉，无咎。

易簡而天下之理得矣，天下之理得而成位乎其中矣。

往者屈也，來者信也。

書

水、火、金、木、土、穀，惟修。

有言逆于汝心，必求諸道；有言遜于汝志，必求諸非道。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

“I transmit but do not create; I trust in and love antiquity.”

“In all things, preparation leads to success; without preparation, failure follows. If words are settled beforehand, there will be no stumbling in speech; if affairs are settled beforehand, there will be no difficulty; if conduct is settled beforehand, there will be no cause for regret; if the course to follow is settled beforehand, there will be no reaching an impasse.”

“There are levies of cloth and thread, levies of grain, and levies of labor service. The gentleman employs one of these and eases the other two.”

Book of Changes (Yijing)

“Great indeed is the primal power of Qian! All things depend upon it for their beginning, and it governs Heaven.”

“Nine in the fourth place: great good fortune; no blame.”

“Through ease and simplicity, the principles of all under Heaven are apprehended. When these principles are apprehended, one establishes one’s place in their midst.”

“What goes contracts; what comes extends.”

Book of Documents (Shujing)

“Water, fire, metal, wood, earth, and grain must be properly managed.”

“When words run contrary to your heart, you must examine whether they accord with the Way; when words comply with your wishes, you must examine whether they depart from the Way.”

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
在昔殷先哲王迪畏天顯小民經德秉哲
自成湯咸至于帝乙成王畏相惟御事
厥棐有恭
政貴有恒辭尚體要不惟好異
詩
俴駟孔群厹矛鋈錞蒙伐有苑虎韔鏤膺
交鞬二弓竹閉緄滕
肅肅謝功召伯營之烈烈征師召伯成之
威儀孔時君子有孝子孝子不匱永錫爾
===
類
燕及皇天克昌厥後
春秋
公如齊公至自齊〔宣公四年〕公如齊五
月公至自齊〔宣公十年〕
取汶陽田〔成公二年〕晉侯使韓穿來言
汶陽之田歸之于齊〔成公八年〕公會
晉侯齊侯宋公衛侯鄭伯曹伯莒子杞
伯同盟于蒲〔成公九年〕會于蕭魚〔襄〕
punctuated:
在昔殷先哲王，迪畏天顯小民，經德秉哲。自成湯咸至于帝乙，成王畏相，惟御事，厥棐有恭。
政貴有恒，辭尚體要，不惟好異。

詩
俴駟孔群，厹矛鋈錞，蒙伐有苑，虎韔鏤膺，交鞬二弓，竹閉緄滕。
肅肅謝功，召伯營之；烈烈征師，召伯成之。
威儀孔時，君子有孝子。孝子不匱，永錫爾類。
燕及皇天，克昌厥後。

春秋
公如齊，公至自齊〔宣公四年〕。公如齊，五月，公至自齊〔宣公十年〕。
取汶陽田〔成公二年〕。晉侯使韓穿來言，汶陽之田歸之于齊〔成公八年〕。公會晉侯、齊侯、宋公、衛侯、鄭伯、曹伯、莒子、杞伯，同盟于蒲〔成公九年〕。會于蕭魚〔襄〕
translation_en:
In former times, the wise kings of Yin followed and reverenced Heaven and showed care for the common people, taking virtue as their constant rule and holding fast to wisdom. From Cheng Tang down to Di Yi, these accomplished kings stood in reverent awe of their ministers; those who managed affairs assisted them with respect.
In government, constancy is prized; in speech, substance and essentials are esteemed. Do not merely delight in novelty.

Book of Odes
The four horses, lightly clad in armor, are well matched; the three-edged spears have butt caps plated with white metal. The feather-covered shields are richly patterned; there are tiger-skin bow cases and carved breast straps, two bows placed crosswise in their cases, bamboo bow braces, and cord bindings.
Imposing are the works at Xie: the Earl of Shao planned them. Mighty is the campaigning host: the Earl of Shao brought it into order.
His dignified bearing is perfectly fitting; the lord has a filial son. The filial son’s devotion never fails: he will forever bestow blessings upon your kind.
He brought peace even to august Heaven and was able to make his descendants flourish.

Spring and Autumn Annals
The duke went to Qi. The duke returned from Qi. 〔Fourth year of Duke Xuan.〕 The duke went to Qi. In the fifth month, the duke returned from Qi. 〔Tenth year of Duke Xuan.〕
The lands of Wenyang were taken. 〔Second year of Duke Cheng.〕 The Marquis of Jin sent Han Chuan to convey the instruction that the lands of Wenyang be returned to Qi. 〔Eighth year of Duke Cheng.〕 The duke met with the Marquis of Jin, the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Earl of Cao, the Viscount of Ju, and the Earl of Qi; together they entered into a covenant at Pu. 〔Ninth year of Duke Cheng.〕 They met at Xiaoyu. 〔Duke Xiang …〕

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
公十一年楚子蔡侯陳侯鄭伯許男
徐子滕子頓子胡子沈子小邾子宋世
子佐淮夷會于申昭公四年
季孫意如叔弓仲孫玃帥師伐莒昭公十
年
齊人取讙及闡齊人歸讙及闡俱哀公
八年
禮記
命市納賈以觀民之所好惡
===
天道至教聖人至德
樂至則無怨禮至則不爭
言而履之禮也行而樂之樂也君子力此
二者以南面而立夫是以天下大平也
第貳塲
論
正心術以立紀綱
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢令具親耕桑禮儀詔文帝十三年
punctuated:
公十一年。楚子、蔡侯、陳侯、鄭伯、許男、徐子、滕子、頓子、胡子、沈子、小邾子、宋世子佐、淮夷會于申。昭公四年。
季孫意如、叔弓、仲孫玃帥師伐莒。昭公十年。
齊人取讙及闡。齊人歸讙及闡。俱哀公八年。
禮記
命市納賈，以觀民之所好惡。
天道至教，聖人至德。
樂至則無怨，禮至則不爭。
言而履之，禮也；行而樂之，樂也。君子力此二者，以南面而立，夫是以天下大平也。
第貳塲
論
正心術以立紀綱。
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢令具親耕桑禮儀詔。文帝十三年。
translation_en:
… the eleventh year of Duke [Xiang].
The Viscount of Chu, the Marquis of Cai, the Marquis of Chen, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu 許, the Viscount of Xu 徐, the Viscount of Teng, the Viscount of Dun, the Viscount of Hu, the Viscount of Shen, the Viscount of Xiaozhu, Zuo, heir apparent of Song, and the Huai Yi assembled at Shen. Fourth year of Duke Zhao.
Jisun Yiru, Shu Gong, and Zhongsun Jue led an army to attack Ju. Tenth year of Duke Zhao.
The men of Qi seized Huan and Chan. The men of Qi returned Huan and Chan. Both passages are from the eighth year of Duke Ai.

Record of Rites
Order the market officials to submit prices, so as to observe the people's likes and dislikes.
The Way of Heaven is the highest teaching; the sage possesses the highest virtue.
When music reaches perfection, there is no resentment; when ritual reaches perfection, there is no contention.
To speak and put one's words into practice is ritual; to act and take delight in doing so is music. The gentleman strives at these two things and stands facing south as ruler; through this, all under Heaven enjoys great peace.

Second Session
Discourse
Rectify the dispositions of the mind in order to establish the governing principles and rules.

Edicts, Proclamations, and Memorials〔One question set from among these [?].〕
Compose, in the manner of the Han, an edict ordering the preparation of ritual procedures for personally ploughing and tending mulberries. Thirteenth year of Emperor Wen.

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
擬唐以張蘊古為大理丞誥武德九年
擬宋太祖親賛孔顔文臣謝表建隆二年
判語五條
文官不許封公侯
蒙古色目人婚姻
見任官輒自立碑
隱匿孳生官畜産
聞有恩赦而故犯
第叁塲
===
策五道
問帝王之心學有關於世道之治忽大矣
然為學之要不外尊德性道問學而已
堯舜禹湯文武固邈不可及肆惟我
太祖
太宗以天縱之資法古為治
列聖相承克闡家學觀其造觀心亭而命儒臣
作記祀方丘而與儒者論心豈不有得
於心學之要乎以至為學士而進星大
punctuated:
擬唐以張蘊古為大理丞誥，武德九年。
擬宋太祖親賛孔顔文臣謝表，建隆二年。
判語五條：
文官不許封公侯。
蒙古色目人婚姻。
見任官輒自立碑。
隱匿孳生官畜産。
聞有恩赦而故犯。
第叁塲
策五道
問：帝王之心學，有關於世道之治忽大矣。然為學之要，不外尊德性、道問學而已。堯舜禹湯文武，固邈不可及。肆惟我太祖、太宗，以天縱之資，法古為治，列聖相承，克闡家學。觀其造觀心亭而命儒臣作記，祀方丘而與儒者論心，豈不有得於心學之要乎？以至為學士而進星大
translation_en:
Compose an appointment proclamation in the voice of the Tang court appointing Zhang Yungu as Assistant in the Court of Judicial Review. Ninth year of Wude [626].
Compose a memorial of thanks from the civil officials on Emperor Taizu of Song personally composing praises of Confucius and Yan Hui. Second year of Jianlong [961].
Five legal judgments:
Civil officials are not permitted to be enfeoffed as dukes or marquises.
Marriage among Mongols and Semu people.
Serving officials erecting commemorative steles for themselves without authorization.
Concealing offspring born to government livestock.
Deliberately committing an offense upon hearing that an imperial amnesty is forthcoming.
Third Session
Five Policy Questions
Question: The learning of the mind practiced by emperors and kings has a profound bearing on order and disorder in the world. Yet the essentials of learning consist simply in honoring one's moral nature and pursuing inquiry and study. Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu are indeed remote and beyond our reach. Now our Taizu and Taizong, endowed with Heaven-given abilities, modeled their governance on antiquity. The successive sage emperors carried on their tradition and fully elucidated the learning of the imperial house. Consider the building of the Pavilion for Contemplating the Mind and the command to Confucian officials to compose a commemorative account, or the sacrifice at the Square Mound and the discussion of the mind with Confucian scholars: do these not show a grasp of the essentials of the learning of the mind? And further, as for the one who, serving as a Hanlin Academician, submitted [?] the Great…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
學正心章講義蒙聘召而講正心誠意
之說者果有裨於德性否耶觀大學衍
義而知濫刑黷兵之非講周易而知齊
家治國之無二理豈不有得於窮理之
要乎以至論克明峻德之一章與論夢
卜求賢之說者果皆有資於問學否耶
聖祖神宗家法具在
經筵進講聖學之要當亦無出於此諸生
駸駸嚮用思欲啓沃
===
聖心者要必有說幸陳之以觀格心之學
問古之聖人著書其大道炳如日星萬世
而下宜服膺而莊誦焉後之爲書有名
眞而實僞者人或從而信之有議論不
本於道顧其言猶或有可取者世傳三
墳爲伏羲神農黃帝所作其言大道遂
以在孔子時已有此書夏小正先儒以
此爲孔子所謂行夏之時者遂以爲夏
之遺書汲冢篇謂爲周書即孔子刪定
punctuated:
學正心章講義，蒙聘召而講正心誠意之說者，果有裨於德性否耶？觀《大學衍義》而知濫刑黷兵之非，講《周易》而知齊家治國之無二理，豈不有得於窮理之要乎？以至論克明峻德之一章，與論夢卜求賢之說者，果皆有資於問學否耶？聖祖神宗家法具在，經筵進講聖學之要，當亦無出於此。諸生駸駸嚮用，思欲啓沃聖心者，要必有說，幸陳之，以觀格心之學。
問：古之聖人著書，其大道炳如日星，萬世而下，宜服膺而莊誦焉。後之爲書，有名眞而實僞者，人或從而信之；有議論不本於道，顧其言猶或有可取者。世傳《三墳》爲伏羲、神農、黃帝所作，其言大道，遂以在孔子時已有此書。《夏小正》，先儒以此爲孔子所謂行夏之時者，遂以爲夏之遺書。《汲冢篇》謂爲《周書》，即孔子刪定
translation_en:
…an exposition of the chapter on rectifying the mind in the Great Learning, and those who, summoned by invitation, expounded the teachings on rectifying the mind and making the intentions sincere—did they indeed contribute to the cultivation of moral nature? By reading the Extended Meaning of the Great Learning, they recognized the wrong of excessive punishments and reckless warfare; by studying the Changes of Zhou, they understood that ordering the family and governing the state do not follow different principles. Did they not thereby grasp the essentials of investigating principle? Furthermore, did discussions of the chapter on “making manifest lofty virtue,” and of seeking worthy men through dreams and divination, all indeed contribute to inquiry and learning? The house traditions of the sagely ancestors and divine forebears remain fully available. The essentials of sagely learning expounded at the Classics Colloquium should likewise extend no further than these. You students are steadily approaching appointment to office. If you aspire to enlighten and nourish the imperial mind, you must surely have something to say. Please set it forth, so that we may see your learning concerning the rectification of the ruler’s mind.
Question: When the sages of antiquity composed books, their great Way shone as brightly as the sun and stars. For myriad generations thereafter, people ought to cherish their teachings and recite them reverently. Among books produced subsequently, some have a reputation for authenticity but are actually spurious, yet people sometimes accept and believe them. Others contain arguments not grounded in the Way, although some of their statements may still merit acceptance. Tradition holds that the Three Ancient Records (San fen) was composed by Fu Xi, Shennong, and the Yellow Emperor. Its words concern the great Way, and it is consequently held that this book already existed in Confucius’s time [?]. Earlier scholars regarded the Lesser Calendar of Xia (Xia xiaozheng) as what Confucius meant by “following the seasons of Xia,” and thus considered it a surviving book of the Xia dynasty. The Jizhong Chapters are said to be the Documents of Zhou, being what Confucius edited and selected…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
之餘或謂三畧太公之書而又爲之講
義辨釋子華子謂程氏書曾子十篇謂
曾子所著彼固皆托而僞焉者然亦何
從而辨其爲僞耶三代而降剽掠聖人
之餘者著荀子以詐相欺者著孫子不
知仁義者著吳子號刑名家者著慎子
刑法苛刻而著尹文子一卷嚴酷督責
之行而著鄧析子二篇大賈乗勢致富
貴著呂氏春秋彼固非聖賢之徒也就
===
中所言果亦有近於道否乎是皆不可
不辨而亦學者格物窮理之大者耳尚
著于篇
問節行治化所關廉耻風俗攸繫蓋下之
效視乎上流之清本乎源故士必廉介
恬退而后可望治化之隆風俗之美也
古者吏之廉介有單車去邑而蒙脂膏
不潤之譏有辭還白紬而來今日清卿
之譽有爲太常以竹爲屏風有出按部
punctuated:
之餘。或謂《三畧》太公之書，而又爲之講義辨釋；《子華子》謂程氏書，《曾子》十篇謂曾子所著。彼固皆托而僞焉者，然亦何從而辨其爲僞耶？三代而降，剽掠聖人之餘者著《荀子》，以詐相欺者著《孫子》，不知仁義者著《吳子》，號刑名家者著《慎子》，刑法苛刻而著《尹文子》一卷，嚴酷督責之行而著《鄧析子》二篇，大賈乗勢致富貴著《呂氏春秋》。彼固非聖賢之徒也，就中所言，果亦有近於道否乎？是皆不可不辨，而亦學者格物窮理之大者耳。尚著于篇。

問：節行治化所關，廉耻風俗攸繫。蓋下之效視乎上，流之清本乎源，故士必廉介恬退，而后可望治化之隆、風俗之美也。古者吏之廉介，有單車去邑而蒙脂膏不潤之譏，有辭還白紬而來今日清卿之譽，有爲太常以竹爲屏風，有出按部
translation_en:
…what remained after Confucius’s editing. Some say that the Three Strategies (San lüe) is a work by Taigong, and have even composed lectures, explanations, and interpretations of it. The Master Zihua (Zihuazi) is said to be a work by Cheng, and the ten chapters of Master Zeng (Zengzi) are said to have been written by Zengzi. These are certainly all falsely attributed forgeries; yet how can their spuriousness be established?

After the Three Dynasties, one who plundered the remnants of the sages’ teachings wrote Master Xun (Xunzi); one who practiced mutual deception through stratagems wrote Master Sun (Sunzi); one who did not understand benevolence and righteousness wrote Master Wu (Wuzi); and one known as an exponent of punishments and names wrote Master Shen (Shenzi). One harsh in penal law wrote the single fascicle of Master Yin Wen (Yin Wenzi); one whose conduct was cruel and exacting wrote the two chapters of Master Deng Xi (Deng Xizi); and a great merchant who exploited his position to attain wealth and rank wrote Master Lü’s Spring and Autumn Annals (Lüshi chunqiu). These men were certainly not followers of the sages and worthies. Yet among their statements, are there indeed any that approach the Way? These matters must all be distinguished, and they are also important instances of the scholar’s investigation of things and exhaustive inquiry into principle. Set forth your account in writing.

Question: Integrity and conduct bear upon government and moral transformation; incorruptibility and a sense of shame are bound up with prevailing customs. Those below look to those above for their example, and a stream’s clarity depends upon its source. Thus only when scholars are incorruptible, principled, content, and retiring can we hope for flourishing government and moral transformation and admirable customs.

Among incorruptible and principled officials of antiquity, there was one who left his county in a single carriage and was subjected to the taunt that its ‘fat and grease had not moistened him’; another declined and returned white silk cloth, earning praise as ‘today’s pure minister.’ One, while serving as Chamberlain for Ceremonials, used bamboo for his screen; another went out to inspect the areas under his jurisdiction…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
斷帶爲燈炷有號獨立使君有稱公清
如水其人可悉言歟古者士之恬退有
不肯留東閤而斥時宰爲小生有不爲
五斗米折腰而即日解印綬有好古嗜
學安於靜退有久次儒館惟求外補有
無書抵政府有不爲呈身御史其人亦
可歷數歟是數公者巍然峻節足以挽
治化之隆凜乎清聲足以反風俗於厚
柰何世道日降潔己之吏寡而貪汙之
===
===
行彰自重之士稀而奔競之風長其有
媿於古人也非一朝夕矣膺世道之責
者可坐視乎伊欲變貪汙以崇廉介之
節革奔競以振恬退之風如砥柱之障
頹波也其道安在願明言之
問三代而下稱致用之學者莫如賈誼陸
贄誼當漢文帝上治安一策曰可爲痛
哭者一可爲流涕者二可爲長太息者
六夫文帝處其常也而誼之言詞乃慷
punctuated:
斷帶爲燈炷，有號獨立使君，有稱公清如水，其人可悉言歟？古者士之恬退，有不肯留東閤而斥時宰爲小生，有不爲五斗米折腰而即日解印綬，有好古嗜學、安於靜退，有久次儒館、惟求外補，有無書抵政府，有不爲呈身御史，其人亦可歷數歟？是數公者，巍然峻節，足以挽治化之隆；凜乎清聲，足以反風俗於厚。柰何世道日降，潔己之吏寡而貪汙之行彰，自重之士稀而奔競之風長，其有媿於古人也，非一朝夕矣。膺世道之責者，可坐視乎？伊欲變貪汙以崇廉介之節，革奔競以振恬退之風，如砥柱之障頹波也，其道安在？願明言之。
問：三代而下，稱致用之學者，莫如賈誼、陸贄。誼當漢文帝，上治安一策，曰：「可爲痛哭者一，可爲流涕者二，可爲長太息者六。」夫文帝處其常也，而誼之言詞乃慷
translation_en:
…one who cut his belt to make a lamp wick; one who was called the “Prefect Who Stands Alone”; and one who was praised as “impartial and pure as water.” Can you identify all these men? Among gentlemen of antiquity who were content to withdraw from advancement, there was one who refused to remain in the eastern pavilion and rebuked the chief minister of his day as a mere youngster; one who would not bend his waist for five pecks of rice and relinquished his seal and sash that very day; one who loved antiquity and delighted in learning, content with quiet retirement; one who spent many years in scholarly offices and sought only an appointment outside the capital; one who sent no letters to the chief councillors; and one who refused to become a “self-presenting Censor.” Can you likewise enumerate these men? These gentlemen’s lofty integrity was sufficient to bring government and moral transformation to flourishing heights; their awe-inspiring reputation for purity was sufficient to restore generosity to social customs. Why, then, as the moral condition of the world declines daily, are officials who keep themselves pure so few, while corrupt conduct is so conspicuous? Why are gentlemen who respect themselves so scarce, while the habit of scrambling for advancement grows? This falling short of the ancients has persisted for far more than a single day. Can those responsible for the moral condition of the world sit by and watch? If we wish to transform corruption and exalt incorruptible integrity, to eradicate the scramble for advancement and revive the spirit of contented withdrawal—like Dizhu, the rock that blocks the surging current—what way should we follow? Please explain clearly.
Question: Among those renowned since the Three Dynasties for learning directed toward practical application, none surpass Jia Yi and Lu Zhi. During the reign of Emperor Wen of Han, Jia Yi submitted a policy essay on good government and security, saying: “There is one matter over which we should weep bitterly, two over which we should shed tears, and six over which we should heave long sighs.” Now Emperor Wen lived in a time of normal order, yet Jia Yi’s language was so impassioned…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
慨激切如是其果皆中當時之病否歟
贄當唐德宗上中書二奏其一論沿邊
守備事宜其失有六其一論均節賦稅
恤百姓其條有七夫德宗處其變也而
贄之敷陳乃從容詳備如是其果皆適
時政之宜否歟昔人稱誼謂董子得聖
人之經而流爲迂晁錯得聖人之權而
流爲詐誼之正而權果何以見歟昔人
稱贄謂智如子房而文則過辯如賈誼
===
而術不疎贄之智與辯果能若是歟方
今
國運熙洽海宇一家固昇平之時矣而邇
年邊塵屢驚桴鼓數起國用匱乏民力
疲困亦不可謂無事也常變無形智者
所慮誼之所陳亦有可舉而行於今日
乎時之急務亦有蹈乎贄之所論者乎
請著于篇以觀致用之學
問法久而弊勢固有必然者而邇年之弊
punctuated:
慨激切如是，其果皆中當時之病否歟？贄當唐德宗，上中書二奏：其一論沿邊守備事宜，其失有六；其一論均節賦稅恤百姓，其條有七。夫德宗處其變也，而贄之敷陳乃從容詳備如是，其果皆適時政之宜否歟？昔人稱誼，謂董子得聖人之經而流爲迂，晁錯得聖人之權而流爲詐，誼之正而權，果何以見歟？昔人稱贄，謂智如子房而文則過，辯如賈誼而術不疎，贄之智與辯，果能若是歟？方今國運熙洽，海宇一家，固昇平之時矣。而邇年邊塵屢驚，桴鼓數起，國用匱乏，民力疲困，亦不可謂無事也。常變無形，智者所慮。誼之所陳，亦有可舉而行於今日乎？時之急務，亦有蹈乎贄之所論者乎？請著于篇，以觀致用之學。
問：法久而弊，勢固有必然者，而邇年之弊
translation_en:
…so impassioned and urgent: did his words indeed all address the ills of his time? During the reign of Emperor Dezong of the Tang, Lu Zhi submitted two memorials from the Secretariat. One discussed arrangements for frontier defense, identifying six failings; the other discussed equalizing and regulating taxation to relieve the people, setting out seven provisions. Dezong faced exceptional circumstances, yet Lu Zhi’s exposition was so measured and comprehensive. Did all his proposals indeed suit the needs of government at that time? Earlier writers praised Jia Yi, saying that Master Dong grasped the sages’ constant principles but drifted into impracticality, while Chao Cuo grasped the sages’ capacity for expedient action but drifted into deceit. What, indeed, shows that Jia Yi combined rectitude with expediency? Earlier writers praised Lu Zhi, saying that his wisdom equaled that of Zifang and his literary skill surpassed it, and that his eloquence equaled Jia Yi’s while his methods were free of impracticality. Could Lu Zhi’s wisdom and eloquence truly have been such?
At present, the fortunes of our dynasty flourish in harmony, and all within the seas form one family: this is certainly an age of peace. Yet in recent years alarms have repeatedly sounded on the frontier and war drums have frequently beaten; state funds are depleted and the people’s resources exhausted. We cannot call this a time free of trouble. Ordinary and exceptional circumstances have no fixed form: this is what the wise ponder. Among Jia Yi’s proposals, are there any that could be adopted and implemented today? Do any urgent affairs of our time fall within the matters Lu Zhi discussed? Set forth your views in an essay, so that we may assess your learning for practical application.
Question: That institutions develop defects over time is surely inevitable in the course of affairs. Yet the defects of recent years…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
於湖廣爲甚往時倉廩餘粮今則逋負
之梗令其恒侵欺之作姦相踵而儲蓄
屢至於空虛往時尺伍足數今則丁竭
於哨守之班財傷於科斂之令而武衛
頓稱乎單弱國稅不加多也而祿米歲
增坐受倍納之苦民戶日加貧也而客
民蠶食且肆兼拜之強郴桂之邊蠻夷
縱暴獻策者以爲非犁庭搗穴不得數
年之安果欲行其言則兵食不足更須
===
動調土兵而土兵之殘忍又慘於邊夷
之侵掠鄂岳諸郡水澇爲災憂民者以
爲非
肆赦免租無以存待哺之輩使盡蠲其租則運
留並竭未能飽齊民之腹而已失軍士
之心伊欲使倉廩歲足常支尺籍名復
舊額祿米無重困之偏客民斷侵奪之
害與夫郴桂之邊籌鄂岳之荒政諸士
子必有見矣願稽古酌今明以告我
punctuated: 於湖廣爲甚。往時倉廩餘粮，今則逋負之梗令其恒，侵欺之作姦相踵，而儲蓄屢至於空虛。往時尺伍足數，今則丁竭於哨守之班，財傷於科斂之令，而武衛頓稱乎單弱。國稅不加多也，而祿米歲增，坐受倍納之苦；民戶日加貧也，而客民蠶食，且肆兼拜之強。郴桂之邊，蠻夷縱暴，獻策者以爲非犁庭搗穴，不得數年之安。果欲行其言，則兵食不足，更須動調土兵，而土兵之殘忍，又慘於邊夷之侵掠。鄂岳諸郡，水澇爲災，憂民者以爲非肆赦免租，無以存待哺之輩。使盡蠲其租，則運留並竭，未能飽齊民之腹，而已失軍士之心。伊欲使倉廩歲足常支，尺籍名復舊額，祿米無重困之偏，客民斷侵奪之害，與夫郴桂之邊籌、鄂岳之荒政，諸士子必有見矣。願稽古酌今，明以告我。
translation_en:
…are particularly severe in Huguang. Formerly, the granaries held surplus grain; now, arrears routinely obstruct the execution of orders [?], fraudulent misappropriation follows upon fraudulent misappropriation, and the reserves repeatedly become empty. Formerly, the military ranks [?] were at full strength; now, manpower is exhausted by rotations of patrol and garrison duty, resources are depleted by orders for levies, and the military defenses have suddenly become weak. State taxes have not increased, yet grain stipends increase each year, leaving the people to suffer the hardship of paying twice over. Resident households grow poorer each day, while immigrant settlers encroach upon them bit by bit and brazenly use their power to engross holdings [?].

On the frontiers of Chen and Gui, the tribal peoples give free rein to violence. Those offering proposals maintain that unless their strongholds are razed and their lairs destroyed, even a few years of peace cannot be secured. Yet if we actually attempt to carry out this proposal, troops and provisions are insufficient, and we must additionally mobilize native troops, whose cruelty is still more terrible than the raids and plundering of the frontier tribes.

In the prefectures of E and Yue, floods have brought disaster. Those concerned for the people maintain that without a general amnesty and remission of land taxes, there is no way to keep alive those awaiting food. But if their land taxes are remitted entirely, both the grain shipped out and that retained locally will be exhausted: before we can fill the bellies of the common people, we will already have lost the soldiers’ allegiance.

If we wish to ensure that the granaries have enough each year for regular expenditure, restore the names on the military registers [?] to their former quotas, prevent grain stipends from imposing an unequal burden of repeated hardship, and end the harm caused by immigrant settlers’ encroachments and seizures—as well as devise frontier plans for Chen and Gui and famine-relief measures for E and Yue—you candidates surely have insights to offer. Examine antiquity, weigh present circumstances, and explain them clearly to me.
