Your solicitude is most generous. How could I dare not exhaust my humble understanding in reply? Moreover, the Jinghu of today is the same Jinghu as in earlier days. I wonder how its administration for securing the people’s welfare and managing military affairs, and its policies for defending the frontiers and relieving disasters, actually compare with those of earlier days. Since our …

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
彞克平僞漢德化涵煦而政令脩明百餘
年矣以倉廩言之昔盈而今則虛以爲梗
令侵欺害之固也豈亦民財之竭官吏之
過乎必也申警催徵之司益嚴出納之法
侵多者重其典梗甚者遷其家而又禁冒
濫清附餘則一省之用可以漸裕矣以尺
伍言之昔充而今則缺以爲班戍科歛害
之是也豈亦處置失度召募無方乎必也
減省哨守之班斷絕科歛之弊募強壯以
===
充伍時衣糧以恤窮而又廣屯種查隱蔽
則武衛之氣可以漸生矣言夫祿米也賦
稅不增於今
宗室日盛於昔重以三倍輸納之橫奪其八
口朞月之供其勢必難繼也今宜申明分
封之例嚴立類納之規或兼撥他省漕運
而牧輕齎或改還隣境歲輸以紓支用而
民力亦可以少蘇矣夫客民也逃戶役而
來商憑客產以自植本輕息重而蠶食孤
punctuated:
彞克平僞漢，德化涵煦，而政令脩明百餘年矣。以倉廩言之，昔盈而今則虛，以爲梗令侵欺害之，固也，豈亦民財之竭、官吏之過乎？必也申警催徵之司，益嚴出納之法，侵多者重其典，梗甚者遷其家，而又禁冒濫、清附餘，則一省之用可以漸裕矣。
以尺伍言之，昔充而今則缺，以爲班戍科歛害之，是也，豈亦處置失度、召募無方乎？必也減省哨守之班，斷絕科歛之弊，募強壯以充伍，時衣糧以恤窮，而又廣屯種、查隱蔽，則武衛之氣可以漸生矣。
言夫祿米也，賦稅不增於今，宗室日盛於昔，重以三倍輸納之橫，奪其八口朞月之供，其勢必難繼也。今宜申明分封之例，嚴立類納之規，或兼撥他省漕運而牧輕齎，或改還隣境歲輸以紓支用，而民力亦可以少蘇矣。
夫客民也，逃戶役而來商，憑客產以自植，本輕息重，而蠶食孤
translation_en:
…[?] subdued the illegitimate Han regime. For more than a hundred years, benevolent moral influence has nurtured the people, and government commands have been well ordered and clear. As for the granaries, formerly they were full, but now they are empty. To attribute this damage to obstruction of orders and embezzlement [?] is certainly reasonable; yet might it also result from the exhaustion of the people’s resources and the faults of officials? The offices responsible for pressing tax collection must be admonished anew, and the rules governing receipts and disbursements made stricter. Those who embezzle heavily should receive heavier penalties, and those who seriously obstruct collection should have their households relocated. If fraudulent and excessive claims are also prohibited and supplementary balances clarified [?], the resources available for the province’s needs can gradually become more abundant.
As for the military ranks [?], formerly they were full, but now they are depleted. It is right to attribute this damage to rotating garrison duty and imposed levies; yet might it also result from improper arrangements and ineffective recruitment? Rotations for patrol and guard duty must be reduced, and abusive levies eliminated. Strong, able-bodied men should be recruited to fill the ranks, and clothing and provisions supplied on time to relieve hardship. If military agricultural colonies are also expanded and concealment investigated, the vigor of the armed forces can gradually revive.
As for grain stipends, tax revenues have not increased, while the imperial clan grows ever more numerous than before. Added to this is the oppressive demand for deliveries at three times the prescribed amount, depriving households of provisions sufficient to feed eight mouths for a full month. Such a situation cannot be sustained. The precedents governing the establishment of princely fiefs should now be reaffirmed, and strict rules instituted for consolidated delivery. Some grain transported as tax from other provinces might also be allocated, with collection in commuted cash [?]; alternatively, annual deliveries from neighboring territories might be reassigned [?] to ease expenditure. The people’s resources could thereby recover somewhat.
As for the migrant population, they evade household service obligations and come to trade, establishing themselves through property held as outsiders. Lending small amounts of principal at heavy interest, they eat away at the resources of the isolated…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
貪黨盛姦叢而虎噬善弱其漸亦可憂也
今宜革其詭寄之姦禁其逼取之忿賣典
田業官司所必稽附報冊籍本貫當備載
而民害亦可以暫省郴桂沿邊之夷歲勞
調度固執事不能已之情也誠如議者犁
庭擣穴則恐窮山之壑難填必如往歲動
調土兵則恐長蛇之毒得肆爲今之計且
當選將治卒禁遏窺伺徐募精勇以減疲
戍之班勤練土著俾爲鄉井之障然後積
===
粟養銳觀釁而動可乎鄂岳洪水之災閭
閻憔悴固執事不忍見之事也若欲租稅
盡免苟可以活涸轍之魚而運留並竭或
無以慰樵蘇之士爲今之計且當停徵省
役稽歉覈穰稍發本地預備之粟以先疲
癃漸徵稔郡儲積之糧以還流徙然後勸
義罰罪濟其春荒可乎書曰事事乃有其
備言處事之當豫也易曰用拯馬壯吉言
處患不可緩也執事之意固然矣而爲之
punctuated:
貪黨盛，姦叢而虎噬善弱，其漸亦可憂也。今宜革其詭寄之姦，禁其逼取之忿。賣典田業，官司所必稽；附報冊籍，本貫當備載，而民害亦可以暫省。
郴桂沿邊之夷，歲勞調度，固執事不能已之情也。誠如議者犁庭擣穴，則恐窮山之壑難填；必如往歲動調土兵，則恐長蛇之毒得肆。爲今之計，且當選將治卒，禁遏窺伺，徐募精勇，以減疲戍之班；勤練土著，俾爲鄉井之障。然後積粟養銳，觀釁而動，可乎？
鄂岳洪水之災，閭閻憔悴，固執事不忍見之事也。若欲租稅盡免，苟可以活涸轍之魚，而運留並竭，或無以慰樵蘇之士。爲今之計，且當停徵省役，稽歉覈穰，稍發本地預備之粟，以先疲癃；漸徵稔郡儲積之糧，以還流徙。然後勸義罰罪，濟其春荒，可乎？
《書》曰：「事事乃有其備。」言處事之當豫也。《易》曰：「用拯馬壯，吉。」言處患不可緩也。執事之意固然矣，而爲之
translation_en:
…Greedy factions flourish and wicked men gather, devouring the good and weak like tigers; this growing tendency, too, is cause for concern. Now we should eliminate their fraudulent registration of property under others’ names and prohibit their angry coercion in obtaining it [?]. Sales and mortgages of landed property must be investigated by the authorities; the parties’ places of original registration should be fully recorded in the registers submitted as supplementary reports. Thus the harm suffered by the people might also be reduced for a time.
The non-Han peoples along the borders of Chen and Gui require exhausting military deployments year after year. This is indeed a circumstance in which you, sir, cannot cease your efforts. If, as some propose, we were to plough up their courts and smash their lairs, I fear that the ravines of those remote mountains would prove impossible to fill. If we invariably mobilize native troops as in past years, I fear that the venom of these great serpents would be given free rein. For the present, we should select commanders and put the troops in order, preventing and checking hostile reconnaissance; gradually recruit picked, courageous men to reduce the rotations of weary garrison troops; and diligently train local inhabitants to serve as a bulwark for their villages. Then we could accumulate grain, nurture our fighting strength, and act when an opening appears. Would this be practicable?
The floods in E and Yue have left the common people worn and distressed: this is indeed something you, sir, cannot bear to see. If all land taxes were remitted, this might save fish stranded in a dried-up cart rut; yet if both the revenues shipped out and those retained locally were exhausted, there might be no means of sustaining the soldiers who gather firewood and cut grass. For the present, we should suspend collections and reduce service obligations, investigate shortages and verify surpluses, and release some of the grain held locally in reserve, giving priority to the exhausted and infirm. We should gradually requisition grain stored in commanderies with plentiful harvests, so that those who have fled and wandered may return. Then we could encourage acts of charity and punish wrongdoing, relieving their spring famine. Would this be practicable?
The Book of Documents says, “For every undertaking, there must be preparation.” This means that affairs should be prepared for in advance. The Book of Changes says, “For rescue, a strong horse: auspicious.” This means that action in the face of trouble must not be delayed. Your intention, sir, is surely so; but carrying it out…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
豈不在人夫智足以燭弊才足以應變
而懷憂國憂民之心者端於今日之當道
有切望焉
punctuated: 豈不在人？夫智足以燭弊、才足以應變，而懷憂國憂民之心者，端於今日之當道有切望焉。
translation_en: …does it not depend on people? As for men whose wisdom suffices to discern abuses, whose ability suffices to respond to changing circumstances, and whose hearts are concerned for the state and the people, it is precisely among those in authority today that I earnestly hope to find them.

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
湖廣□試錄後序
此正德丙子湖廣鄉試錄也
錄者何錄其人也錄其文也
其人爲何監臨也提調也監
試也主考也同考也諸執事
也與凡中式者名第也其文
爲何孔子子思孟軻易書詩
===
春秋禮記之義也論也表也
策也錄其人將何爲者示勸
戒也錄其文又將何爲者驗
邪正也勸戒著上下胥焉以
懼邪正明趨向胥焉以定懼
則日進於善定則日堅其守
古之君子懼人之有邪心也
punctuated:
湖廣□試錄後序

此正德丙子湖廣鄉試錄也。錄者何？錄其人也，錄其文也。其人爲何？監臨也，提調也，監試也，主考也，同考也，諸執事也，與凡中式者名第也。其文爲何？孔子、子思、孟軻、《易》、《書》、《詩》、《春秋》、《禮記》之義也，論也，表也，策也。錄其人將何爲者？示勸戒也。錄其文又將何爲者？驗邪正也。勸戒著，上下胥焉以懼；邪正明，趨向胥焉以定。懼則日進於善，定則日堅其守。古之君子懼人之有邪心也，
translation_en:
Postface to the Huguang □ Examination Record

This is the record of the Huguang Provincial Examination held in the bingzi year of the Zhengde reign [1516]. What does it record? It records the people and their compositions. Who are these people? The Supervising Official, the Proctor, the examination monitors, the chief Examiner, the Associate Examiners, the various functionaries, and the names and rankings of all successful candidates. What are these compositions? Expositions of the meaning of the teachings of Kongzi, Zisi, and Meng Ke, and of the Book of Changes, Book of Documents, Book of Odes, Spring and Autumn Annals, and Book of Rites; discourses; memorials; and policy essays. What is the purpose of recording the people? To provide encouragement and admonition. And what is the purpose of recording their compositions? To discern the deviant and the correct. When encouragement and admonition are manifest, those above and below alike become vigilant; when the deviant and the correct are clear, all become settled in the direction they pursue. Through vigilance, they advance daily toward goodness; through settled purpose, they grow daily firmer in what they uphold. The gentlemen of antiquity feared that people might harbor deviant intentions…

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
樹之□聲著之物采德以先
之法以垂之政以糾之禮義
廉恥以範之忠信誠慤以要
之懸之中制而使人趨焉趨
之而後舉之舉之而後官之
爵祿以昭其等威刑以警其
怠有賓興之儀有勸駕之典
===
有蔽賢之誚有連坐之誅使
不入于邪是故舉者無德色
受者無慚容無遺才無倖進
以成其名而天下治用是道
也錄也者先王之遺意也我
朝以之豈無謂乎天下後世觀
是錄也將不有指而稱之曰
punctuated:
樹之□聲，著之物采，德以先之，法以垂之，政以糾之，禮義廉恥以範之，忠信誠慤以要之，懸之中制而使人趨焉。趨之而後舉之，舉之而後官之，爵祿以昭其等，威刑以警其怠。有賓興之儀，有勸駕之典，有蔽賢之誚，有連坐之誅，使不入于邪。是故舉者無德色，受者無慚容，無遺才，無倖進，以成其名，而天下治，用是道也。
錄也者，先王之遺意也。我朝以之，豈無謂乎？天下後世觀是錄也，將不有指而稱之曰：
translation_en:
…They established for people an exemplary reputation [?] and made it manifest through ceremonial adornments; led them through virtue, handed down laws for them, corrected them through governance, molded them through ritual propriety, righteousness, integrity, and a sense of shame, and bound them to loyalty, trustworthiness, sincerity, and honesty. They set up a balanced standard and directed people toward it. Only after people followed it were they recommended, and only after recommendation were they appointed to office. Rank and emoluments made their standing clear; the威 severity of punishments warned them against neglect. There were ceremonies for honoring and recommending worthy men and rites for urging them to set forth; there was censure for concealing worthy men and punishment through collective liability, so that people would not stray into wickedness. Thus those who recommended others assumed no air of having bestowed a favor, and those who received recommendation showed no shame. No talent was overlooked, and none advanced through mere good fortune. Their reputations were thereby established, and the realm was well governed: this was the way employed.
The compilation of an examination record preserves the intentions of the former kings. Can our dynasty’s adoption of it be without purpose? When people throughout the realm and in later generations read this record, will there not be those who point to it and declare: …

title: 正德十一年湖廣鄉試錄
text:
某人某經也湖之才也正
德丙子所取之士也建茲功
也立茲事也爲臣而忠爲子
而孝其偉然振古之人豪乎
又從而言曰是科也某爲考
官也某爲監試也某爲提調
也某爲監臨也得文如是得
===
人如是豈不與有光哉否則
自有公論而不可逭者在則
又烏用是錄也爲哉監臨而
下爵里名氏前序備之矣茲
不列
直隸保定府雄縣儒學教諭
魏綸謹序
punctuated:
「某人某經也，湖之才也，正德丙子所取之士也。建茲功也，立茲事也，爲臣而忠，爲子而孝，其偉然振古之人豪乎！」又從而言曰：「是科也，某爲考官也，某爲監試也，某爲提調也，某爲監臨也。得文如是，得人如是，豈不與有光哉！」否則，自有公論而不可逭者在，則又烏用是錄也爲哉？監臨而下爵里名氏，前序備之矣，茲不列。
直隸保定府雄縣儒學教諭魏綸謹序。
translation_en:
…“So-and-so specialized in such-and-such a Classic: a talented man of Huguang, selected in the bingzi year of the Zhengde reign [1516]. He achieved these merits and accomplished these deeds; loyal as a subject and filial as a son—surely he is an outstanding figure, a hero such as has been known since antiquity!” They will then add: “In this examination, so-and-so was Examiner, so-and-so was an Examination Monitor, so-and-so was Proctor, and so-and-so was Supervising Official. Having obtained writings like these and selected men like these, do they not share in the glory?” Otherwise, there will inevitably be public judgment that cannot be escaped; what use, then, would this record serve? The ranks, native places, and names of the Supervising Official and those below him are fully provided in the preceding preface and are not listed here.
Preface respectfully composed by Wei Lun, Instructor of the Confucian School of Xiong County, Baoding Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region.
